images.alt_en: Illustration inspired by the story: Nine hours and four minutes before periapsis, forty children in the Commons of Ninefold Station practised the count with the lights on, which everyone agreed was cheating.
images.alt_sl: Ilustracija po zgodbi: Devet ur in štiri minute pred periapsido je štirideset otrok v Skupni dvorani postaje Ninefold vadilo štetje pri prižganih lučeh, kar je bilo po splošnem mnenju goljufanje.
